issues.detail: Hebrew רַבִּים רַחֲמָיו (ravim rachamav) means 'His mercies are great/many' (abstract noun 'mercy/compassion'), but Chinese renders it as '祂的肚腸很多' (His intestines/bowels are many), which is a literal anatomical rendering that would mislead a Chinese reader into thinking of physical organs rather than compassion/mercy.
